title: Working with text
objective: Build messages with template strings and use string methods
story: The rocket will exchange messages with space stations. We'll need to join messages, turn them into capitals and search for words inside them. Today we become masters of **text (strings)**.

sections.title: Template strings: backticks and ${ }
Length and letters
sections.body:
- `text.length` gives how many characters the text has.
- `text[0]` gives the first character; counting **starts at 0**.

```js
const word = "rocket";
console.log(word.length);  // 6
console.log(word[0]);      // r
```

sections.title: String methods
sections.body:
| Method | What it does | Example → Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toUpperCase()` | Capitals | `"nova".toUpperCase()` → `"NOVA"` |
| `toLowerCase()` | Lowercase | `"NOVA".toLowerCase()` → `"nova"` |
| `includes(x)` | Is x inside? | `"Moonlight".includes("Moon")` → `true` |
| `slice(a, b)` | The part from a to b | `"starship".slice(0, 4)` → `"star"` |
| `trim()` | Removes spaces at the start/end | `"  hey ".trim()` → `"hey"` |
| `replace(a, b)` | Replaces a with b | `"Moon".replace("Moon", "Mars")` → `"Mars"` |

Methods don't change the text; they give you a **new** text, so store the result in a variable.

sections.title: A tip for comparing text
sections.body:
Upper and lower case matter: `"Mars" === "mars"` is `false`! When you compare what someone typed, turn both sides into the same case first:

```js
const answer = "MARS";
console.log(answer.toLowerCase() === "mars");  // true
```

examples.title: Template string
examples.note: On most keyboards the backtick is on the key to the left of 1, above Tab.

examples.title: String methods

tasks.title: Welcome message
tasks.prompt: Use a template string to put `Welcome Alex, target: Mars!` into `greeting`. The name and planet must come from the variables (`${...}`); then print it.
hints: Start and end with a backtick `.

tasks.title: Call sign
tasks.prompt: Every ship has a call sign: its name in **capitals**, a dash and the **number of letters** in the name. If `name` is "nova", `callSign` should be `NOVA-4`.

tasks.title: Message scanner
tasks.prompt:
Inspect the incoming message:

- `isUrgent`: does the message contain the word `"Alert"`? (`includes`)
- `title`: the first 6 characters of the message (`slice`), that is `"Alert:"`

challenge.title: Read it backwards
challenge.prompt:
`reversed` should be `word` written backwards, and `isPalindrome` should tell whether the word reads the same backwards. "radar" is still "radar" backwards!

Hint: `word.split("")` splits the letters into a list, `.reverse()` turns the list around, `.join("")` joins it back together. We'll look at lists in detail soon.

project_task.title: Status bar
project_task.prompt:
There will be a status bar at the top of the game. Create the `status` variable with a template string:

- The ship's name in **capitals**
- The number of stars with `/10` (how many of the 10 stars were collected)
- The number of lives

If `shipName` is "Eagle", expected: `EAGLE | Stars: 3/10 | Lives: 2`
